title: My Sister-in-Law Forged a Deed, Sold My B&B, and Gave Me $6K. So I Served Justice and Tea.
description: When my sister-in-law forged a deed, sold my inherited Victorian B&B for $780K, and handed me a $6,000 check, she thought she'd won. But a hidden notarized partnership document turned the tables. Now she scrubs toilets under an apron reading 'Checked-Out Trust' at the Inn of Deceit. #RevengeStory #FamilyBetrayal #InnOfDeceit
thumb_text: SHE SOLD MY INN, NOW SHE SCRUBS ITS TOILETS
pinned_comment: What would you do if your sister-in-law handed you a $6,000 check after secretly selling your family's $780,000 B&B? Share your story in the comments.
